__3 A foot. 
__4 A limb, part, member. 
__5 The body; cf. आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु [[Kaṭh.

.]] 
__6 A reed. 
__7 Pleasure, delight. 
-Comp. 
-अक्षः 
__1 a carriage-axle. 
__2 a measure of length (=104 aṅgulas). 
-अङ्गम् 
__1 any part of a carriage. 
__2 particularly, the wheels of a carriage; रथो रथाङ्गध्वनिना विजज्ञे [[

]]; [[Ś. 7. 10.]] 
__3 a discus, especially of Viṣṇu; चक्रधर

सततं बिभर्षि भुवनेषु रूढये [[Śi. 15. 26.]] 
__4 a potter's wheel. 
(-ङ्गः) the ruddy goose. °आह्वयः, °आह्वानः, °नामकः, °नामन् m. the ruddy goose (चक्रवाक); रथाङ्गनामन् वियुतो रथाङ्गश्रोणिबिम्बया । अयं त्वां पृच्छति रथी मनोरथशतैर्वृतः ॥ [[

]]; रथाङ्गाह्वानानां भवति विधुरम् [[Udb.]]; (the male bird is said by poets to be separated from the female at night, and to be united at sun-rise). °पाणिः N. of Viṣṇu; रथाङ्गपाणेः पटलेन रोचिषा [[Śi. 1. 21]]; दुरन्तवीर्यस्य रथाङ्गपाणेः [[Bhāg.]] 
-अभ्रः a reed cane. 
-अर्थकः a small carriage. 
-अश्वः a carriage-horse. 
-आयुधकः a kind of bow. 
-आरोहः one who fights from a chariot. 
-ईशः a warrior fighting from a chariot. 
-ईषा, -शा the pole of a carriage; रथेषाश्च रथेषाभिः … संगतैः सहिताः [[

.]] 
-उडुपः, -पम् the body of a chariot. 
-उद्वहः, -उपस्थः the seat of a chariot, the driving-box; रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् [[

.]] 
-कट्या, -कडद्या an assemblage of chariots. 
-कल्पकः an officer who is in charge of a king's chariots. 
-करः, -कारः 
__1 a coach-builder, carpenter, wheel-wright; रथकारः स्वकां भार्यां सजारां शिरसावहत् [[

.]] 
__2 N. of a caste called सौधन्वन (q. v.); तस्मादत्रैवर्णिको रथकारः [[ŚB. on

.]] °न्यायः The rule according to which the रूढ अर्थ is stronger than the यौगिक अर्थ; cf. योगाद्रूढिर्बलीयसी. This is discussed and established in connection with the word रथकार by Jaimini and शबर in [[

-50.]] 
-कुटुम्बिकः, -कुटुम्बिन् m. a charioteer, coachman. 
-कुबरः, -रम् the pole or shaft of a carriage; कूबरा रथकूबरैः … संगतैः सहिताः [[

.]] 
-केतुः the flag of a chariot. 
-क्षोभः the jolting of a chariot; रथक्षोभपरिश्रमम् [[

.]] 
-गणकः an officer who counts chariots. 
-गर्भकः a litter, palanquin. 
-गुप्तिः f. a fence of wood or iron with which a chariot is provided as a protection from collision. 
-घोषः the rattling of a chariot. 
-चरणः, -पादः 
__1 a chariot-wheel; धृतरथचरणोऽभ्ययाच्चलद्गुः [[

.]] 
__2 the सुदर्शन wheel; रथाङ्गे चन्द्रार्कौ रथचरणपाणिः शर इति [[Śivamahimna 18.]] 
__2 the ruddy goose. 
-चर्या chariot-exercise, the use of a chariot, travelling by carriage; अनभ्यस्तरथचर्याः [[

.]] 
-जङ्घा the hinder part of a chariot. 
-ज्वरः a crow. 
-दुर्गम् the throng of chariots. 
-धुर् f. the shaft or pole of a chariot. 
-नाभिः f. the nave of the wheel of a chariot; रथनाभिरिवाभिख्यायेत [[Ait.

.]] 
-नीडः the inner part or seat of a chariot. 
-पुंगवः a chief or distinguished warrior. 
-बन्धः 
__1 the fastenings or harness of a chariot. 
__2 a league of warriors. 
-महोत्सवः, [Page1328-1] 
-यात्रा the solemn procession of an idol placed in a car (usually drawn by men). 
-मुखम् the forepart of a carriage. 
-युद्धम् ‘a chariot-fight’, a fight between combatants mounted on chariots. 
-योगः a team (of horses etc.) on a chariot; [[Bṛ. Up.]] 
-योजकः a charioteer, harnesser of a chariot. 
-वंशः a number of chariots. 
-वर्त्मन् n., 
-वीथिः f. highway, main road. 
-वारकः son of a Śūdra and a Sairandhrī. 
-वाहः 
__1 a carriage-horse. 
__2 charioteer. 
-विज्ञानम्, -विद्या the art of driving chariots. 
-शक्तिः f. the staff which supports the banner of a war-chariot; रथशक्तिं मुमोचासौ दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव [[

.]] 
-शाला a coach-house, carriage-shed. 
-शास्त्रम्, -शिक्षा the art of driving a chariot, coachmanship. 
-सप्तमी the seventh day in the bright half of Māgha.
A Vedic Sāma; स्वरादिविशेषानुपूर्वीमात्रस्वरूपे ऋगक्षरव्यतिरिक्तं यद् गानं तद् रथन्तरम् । (सामर्चिकभाष्यम्); एतद्रथन्तरमग्नौ प्रोतम् [[Ch.
]] (com. रथो मायारूपो विग्रहः तं तरत्यनेन तद्रथन्तरम् । ‘अहं ब्रह्मास्मि’
ind. ‘Chariot against chariot’, in closest fight.

a. 
(-की f.) [रथ-ठन्] 
__1 Riding in a carriage. 
__2 The owner of a carriage. 
-कः A cartwright.

a. [रथ-इनि] 
__1 Riding or driving in a carriage. 
__2 Possessing or owning a carriage. -m. 
__1 An owner of a carriage. 
__2 A warrior who fights from a chariot; आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु । बुद्धिं तु सारथिं विद्धि मनः प्रग्रहमेव च ॥ [[Kaṭh.

.]] 
__3 A man of क्षत्रिय caste. 
__4 A driver. 
-नी A number of carriages or chariots.

a. 
__1 Possessing a carriage. 
__2 Riding in a carriage. 
__3 Quick, speedy. 
-रः = रथिन् m.

Ved. 
__1 Riding in a chariot. 
__2 Furnished with a carriage. 
__3 A coachman. 
__4 A guide, leader.

[रथं वहति यत्] 
__1 A chariot-horse; धावन्त्यमी मृगजवाक्षमयेव रथ्याः [[Ś. 1. 8]]; [[Śi. 4. 14.]] 
__2 A part of a chariot. 
-Comp. 
-चयः a team of horses. 
-विरथ्यः N. of Śiva.
__1 A road for carriages; (hence) a high-way, main road; भूयो भूयः सबिधनगरीरथ्यया पर्यटन्तम् [[

.]] 
__2 A place where many roads meet. 
__3 A number of carriages or chariots; रथ्याघोषैर्बृंहणैर्बारणानाम् [[Śi. 18. 3]]; अश्वीयैरौक्षकैर्मानुष्यकै रथ्याभिरौष्ट्रकैः [[Dharmābhyudayamahākāvya 2. 26.]] 
-Comp. 
-पङ्क्तिः a row of streets. 
-मुखम् entrance to a road. 
-मृगः a dog.
